Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有很多人不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。有很多人吃植物以后就吃坏肚子了，因为他们吃了毒。那个时候，有一个老人叫神农，他什么植物都觉得好吃，不怕生病，不怕毒。他希望别人也可以吃好吃的植物。可是他知道，如果他们还怕吃毒，不会吃他喜欢的植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the people become ill, add a physical detail such as “他们肚子疼得弯下了腰” to show the consequence more vividly.
2. After introducing 神农, add his inner thought, such as “神农想：我要帮助大家找到能吃的植物。” This can show why he cares about other people.

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete consequence of eating poisonous plants without conflicting with the story.
The learner already says that Shennong hopes other people can eat good plants.
